# Third-party Rust source notices

Generated from the pinned production-crate Cargo source graph, including build/test/bindgen dependencies.
The separately locked, non-shipping fuzz harness is outside this mobile distribution inventory.
This preserves upstream notice texts; it is not a choice of SDK license, legal approval,
or proof that every listed crate is linked into every platform binary.
